description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Consumer Affairs Authority Act No. 9 of 2003 (Amended). Direction No.95 Low - Density Polyethylene -(LDPE). Linear Low - Density Polyethylene -(LLDPE)
categorisation: This gazette contains a special direction issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, which establishes regulatory requirements for traders regarding the sale of plastic bags. It creates legal obligations for businesses, specifies prohibited materials, and mandates pricing disclosure requirements, making it a legal/regulatory matter under Type 5.
